cells.name: Hibernate
cells.meaning: Rest is the task right now — everything else can wait.

cells.name: Gentle Drift
cells.meaning: Low on fuel and feeling flat — small, soft steps only.

cells.name: Tender Space
cells.meaning: Calm but running on empty — be gentle with yourself.

cells.name: Quiet Glow
cells.meaning: Peaceful and settled, just low on energy — enjoy the stillness.

cells.name: Ground First
cells.meaning: Some energy, but unsettled — steady yourself before anything else.

cells.name: Slow Warm
cells.meaning: Warming up slowly — low-pressure tasks fit best.

cells.name: Ready to Try
cells.meaning: Settled and willing — a good moment to start something.

cells.name: Activate
cells.meaning: Energy is up but so is friction — channel it before you use it.

cells.name: Flow Entering
cells.meaning: Getting going, though mood's still catching up — ease in.
cells.because: getting going while your mood catches up

cells.name: Full Flow
cells.meaning: Steady energy, clear head — good for focused work.

cells.name: Creative Peak
cells.meaning: Energised and in a good place — great for ideas and making things.

cells.name: Regain Base
cells.meaning: Lots of energy but mood is scattered — find your footing first.

cells.name: Storm Mode
cells.meaning: Wired and on edge — high energy needs an outlet, not a task yet.

cells.name: Release First
cells.meaning: Charged up and steady — let some energy out before diving in.

cells.name: Peak Flow
cells.meaning: High energy, feeling good — your best window for big things.
cells.because: full of energy and feeling good

timelines.label: Now
timelines.definition: Due within the next 60 minutes, or happening now.

timelines.label: Later today
timelines.definition: Due in more than 1 hour but before the end of today.

timelines.label: This week
timelines.definition: Due tomorrow or within the next 7 days.

timelines.label: This month
timelines.definition: Due in more than 7 days and up to 4 weeks.

timelines.label: Months
timelines.definition: Due in more than 4 weeks and up to 12 months.

timelines.label: No deadline
timelines.definition: No due date and no consequence for delay; user-chosen timing.

timelines.label: Overdue
timelines.definition: The deadline has already passed (any amount of time).

timelines.label: Recurring
timelines.definition: Repeats on a schedule (e.g. daily meds routine, weekly report). The engine uses the NEXT occurrence to set T0-T5 for urgency.
